levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن عبد الحكم

notes: Three isnads carry the same saying: three groups, not variants
«بإسناده» in the second and third groups stands for the rest of the first isnad (مهاجر, عامر, جابر): the text does not repeat it, so it is written as the back_reference
«كتبت مع غلامي نافع» : Nafi' carried the letter and is not a link; «كتبت» is Amir's own act, and Jabir is the one written to, who answers
«عشية جمعة رجم الأسلمي» is the scene; the saying is abridged («وذكر الحديث إلى آخره»)
The dash in «ابن أبي - ذئب» is a stray mark: read as «ابن أبي ذئب»
